pack.lilybloom.hd_32x.description: Lily Bloom textures for 32x packs (Faithful 32x). Turns on by itself
pack.lilybloom.hd_64x.description: Lily Bloom textures for 64x packs (Faithful 64x). Turns on by itself
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.lilybloom: Blooming lily pads in pink, white, yellow and blue with growth stages (bud, half-open, bloom), and big lily pads in three sizes (2x2, 3x3 and 4x4) with a big flower of the same colours. Bone meal grows them, they bloom on their own and generate in swamps. Shear the flower off to get a Water Lily that can be planted on the ground or in a flower pot. 32x and 64x textures switch on by themselves with packs like Faithful. Required on both server and client.
modmenu.summaryTranslation.lilybloom: Blooming lily pads in four colours, big 2x2 to 4x4 lily pads, and a Water Lily flower you can pot.
